text:
alice: heads up — we had a customer hit a cascade fallback to the small-quant variant when eu-west-1 capacity clipped. request included headers: `x-region: eu-west-1`, `x-tier: standard` and a bunch of retries.
ben: do we treat region hint as hard affinity or soft preference? SDK docs currently say region_hint is advisory.
carmen: routing policy today is: region preference -> tier preference -> variant priority. we also apply a cross-region penalty score to avoid hot-spotting. suspect penalty is too aggressive for some standard-tier customers.
priya: can you paste exact request headers and any routing debug metadata from telemetry? quota/usage could've forced fallback too.
alice: paste: ``\nx-region: eu-west-1\nx-tier: standard\nx-debug-route: 0\nx-request-id: r-9f8a\n``
also telemetry: `route_decision: cross-region-penalty(12) -> fallback: small-quant-v2` and `retry_count:2`
sam: we already have an internal debug header `x-rw-route-sim=1` that simulates routing without committing — but it's org-gated and not exposed in public SDKs. could expand it so SEs can repro.
ben: risky to expose widely, customers might flip and paper-over capacity problems. but exposing as readonly simulation (no state change) + obfuscated logs seems ok.
carmen: also console UX gap: no per-variant fallback rate chart. ops can't see how often standard-tier falls back to smaller variants or cross-region. suggest new metric "fallback_rate_by_variant" and a graph on the model route page. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
priya: agree re metrics. plus we need taggable telemetry so we can slice by `org_id` (hashed), `region_hint`, `tier`. add those fields to the route_trace event.
alice: API contract question: adding headers like `x-rw-tier-override` or `x-rw-route-sim` — do we need API version bump? my vote: keep names prefixed with x-rw- and default ignore if unknown. backward-compatible. gate simulation via org feature-flag.
sam: proposed header shapes: ``\nX-RW-Route-Sim: simulate-only\nX-RW-Tier-Override: dedicated|standard|burst\nX-RW-Debug-Flags: route_trace=1,show_penalty_breakdown=1\n``
ben: also we should rate-limit usage of Tier-Override for safety in Dedicated pools. we can enforce at edge with quota checks.
priya: ops/console needs an event that surfaces penalty breakdown: so graph can show contributors like queueing_penalty, cross_region_penalty, quant_size_penalty. map to telemetry keys now.
carmen: i'll draft the routing-core PR to make cross-region-penalty configurable per-tier and emit `route_trace` with the fields above. will attach unit tests for penalty thresholds.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: routing-policy-v2 -> runner-group-3 (10%)
alice: timeline: carmen PR + telemetry mapping by EOD tomorrow, SDK flag exposure after feature-flag infra ready.
sam: i'll sketch SDK patch to expose simulate header behind ff and a CLI dev-mode toggle.
ben: please post minimal reproducible curl example so support can repro:
``\ncurl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\n -H 'X-Region: eu-west-1' \\n -H 'X-RW-Route-Sim: simulate-only' \\n -d '{"input":"test"}' \\n https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
``
carmen: ack. creating ticket RN-4827 for console metric + RN-4828 for routing-core config. assigning to me + priya.
alice: scheduling 30m sync with obs + sdk tomorrow 10:00am UTC to align fields. thanks all :thumbsup:
